run_visualize_episodes: run the visualize_episodes script to convert tfrecord episodes into HTML visualizations
run_visualize_episodes_with_limit: run visualize_episodes with a limit of 5 episodes from a tfrecord input file
run_visualize_episodes_with_output_dir: run visualize_episodes to output HTML files to a specified output directory
convert_episode: convert an episode protobuf into a list of step dictionaries with screenshot, action, and id fields
visualize_episodes_main: run the main entry point to read tfrecord episodes and write HTML visualization files
